selection_decision.justification: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct in 4-bit NF4 achieves 58.96% overall accuracy, outperforming Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (47.44%) by +11.52 percentage points (95% paired bootstrap CI: [+8.40, +14.56] pp, p < 0.0001). Crucially, it demonstrates strong multi-step mathematical reasoning (+31.00 pp on math word problems) and cuts the stale-fact error rate nearly in half from 41.00% to 22.00% on Gate G-M. It strictly complies with Gate G-R's assistant resident VRAM budget (1416.0 MB process VRAM vs <= 1536.0 MB cap). While Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct represents an energy-efficient Pareto point (68.80 J/correct vs 120.40 J/correct), its 33.5% math accuracy and 41% stale-fact error rate create severe ceiling and headroom distortions that undermine verifier training (Step 3) and Prototype 1 quality gating.
